description: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Discord, Telegram, Webex and generic webhooks of the workspace: name, kind, events, project, on or off, failures, last error, and with webhook (an id) its last 30 deliveries (event, delivered or failed, HTTP status, error). Never returns a webhook URL or signing secret. Adding or changing webhooks is done in the dashboard; a person can resend a delivery with the CLI (appforshare webhooks redeliver). Read only. Pro and Team, Owner or Admin.
